messages:
Dana: FYI customer reported billing discrepancy: after a router hot-restart their streaming session resumed and a toolcall fired twice. ledger shows two confirmed writes.
Chris: any minimal trace?
Dana: redacted trace: 
```
router: restart session=app-11 seq=164 reason=hot_restart
stream: truncated session=app-11 truncated_tokens=20
toolcall: id=tc-A12 status=ok tokens=16
client: reconnect session=app-11a resume_from=162
toolcall: id=tc-A12 status=ok tokens=16 (replayed)
ledger: write confirmed tenant=team-foo tokens=32
```
Priya: Right now we flip confirmed on toolcall_done. For restart/evict races that is racy.
Hannah: Quick mitigation: dedupe ledger writes by (canonical_toolcall_id, tenant) within a 2m window. Might help short term.
Chris: downside: could mask legit retries where the toolcall actually runs twice intentionally. Need canonical_commit_id to be authoritative.
Dana: design suggestion: toolcall events are written provisional=true with a commit_hint. On client commit (ack/end-of-stream) emit commit event with commit_id which reconcile job uses to confirm and dedupe.
Priya: agrees. Also add a per-session flag 'streaming=true' so we only provisionalize when necessary. Non-stream requests remain unchanged.
Hannah: data model: provisional_ledger rows: (tenant, session, canonical_toolcall_id, commit_hint, tokens, created_at). Reconcile groups by commit_id, collapses duplicates, writes single confirmed aggregate. TTL for leftover provisional rows.
Chris: telemetry: new metrics provisional_writes, reconciled_confirms, duplicate_toolcall_hits. Expose tenant-scoped rates (low-cardinality).
Priya: console: show an orange pill "pending tokens" next to request totals; in request timeline show events: toolcall -> provisional -> reconciled_at. Hover text explains provisional semantics.
Dana: rollback scenarios: if commit doesn't arrive and TTL expires, reconcile should mark provisional rows as orphaned and either discard or emit manual review event. Ops wants a report.
Hannah: rollout: feature flag billing.provisional_v1. Enable on staging, then 5% hosted, 100% dedicated opt-in. Monitor reconcile latency and DB write load.
Chris: perf note: provisional writes increase DB QPS and retention. Suggest append-only provisional table with TTL index and compact reconcile worker to delete after confirming.
Priya: API contract change: router must set canonical_toolcall_id and a commit_hint on toolcall events. Client SDKs should send commit_ack when they fully receive the response. Backward compatibility: if no commit_ack arrives, provisional TTL expires and we handle as orphaned.
Dana: quick repro for local QA:
1) run router with restart_interval=1s (dev only)
2) stream ~180 tokens with toolcall at seq ~150
3) trigger restart midstream, reconnect and replay toolcall
Expected: one confirmed invoice after reconcile. Current: two confirmed.
Hannah: ops alerts: fire if duplicate_toolcall_rate > 0.3% over 5m or reconcile_p95 > 30s. Also alert if provisional_table_size > threshold.
Chris: short-term stopgap: ledger will ignore duplicate canonical_toolcall_id writes that come from different session ids if they occur within 60s and token counts match exactly. Not perfect but buys time.
Dana: owners: Dana (router + events), Chris (ledger + reconcile), Priya (console + SDK docs), Hannah (telemetry/alerts). I'll draft RFC and sequence diagrams.
ops-bot: noted. will queue canary once PR is open.
deploy-bot: canary queued for branch dana/prov-ledger. targets: staging-canary-3.
Priya: UX follow-up: add filter on billing dashboard for pending>0 so support can triage.
Hannah: I'll add panels to billing dashboard and a small playbook for investigating orphan provisional rows.
Chris: will prototype provisional table design tonight and run a write load sim.
Dana: thanks all. RFC will land in thread when ready. Please add edge cases in comments.
